purpose: A frozen scalar/array/object specification for independently authored fresh gameplay logic. This is not application source, an old save import, or proof of new-game balance/implementation.
adoptionRule: Adopt listed values as the numeric baseline unless MASTER-PLAN explicitly states a deliberate change. Record before/after/reason in the fresh data ledger. Never import/copy old executable modules or alter the old parity oracle.

parityEvidence.status: Passed during earlier assessment before planning-only scope; not rerun for this documentation task and does not certify the future game.

value.d:
Your people huddle in a cave mouth while something wet and heavy moves in the dark outside. You have flint, forty spears, and a name people will follow.

The fire is small. It will not last both the night and the strangers at the treeline.

ch.log: You shared the first fire. The strangers stayed, and they remembered.
You took the flint. The strangers did not stay, but your stores grew.

value.d: The smelters work day and night. A trader from downriver offers a shipment on credit, with terms you cannot read.

ch.log: The bronze arrived. So did the debt.
You dug your own ore. Slower, but yours.

value.d: Iron changes what a border means. Scouts return with maps of three valleys and the names of the warlords who hold them.

ch.log: You struck first, and the valley learned your banner.

value.d: They call you sovereign now, mostly to your face. The old families want a council; your captains want a throne.

ch.log: A council sits. Slower decisions, deeper roots.
You took the crown alone. No one argued twice.

value.d: A monk brings you a jar of black grain that turns stone into gravel. Walls that took a century to raise now have a countdown on them.

ch.log: You buried it. Someone else will dig it up.

value.t: Chapter VI — Smoke Over the Valley
value.d: Rail and furnace. Your realm fields in a week what once took a season.

ch.log: You spared the valleys. Your rivals did not.

value.d: Satellites, not scouts. Your hero — once a spear-carrier at a cave mouth — commands from a screen. One banner on the map is still not yours.

ch.log: The last banner came down. The age is yours.

value.n: Equip a full set of gear
